name: Shamrock Foodservice Warehouse
old_description: We’re into fresh - meats, seafood, produce and dairy, that is. We also stock disposables, kitchen supplies and more! So whatever you’re cooking up, you can find it at our wholesale restaurant supply store in Phoenix, AZ!
about:
Shamrock Foodservice Warehouse, founded in 1926, opened its Phoenix, Arizona location in January 2015 as a 30,000-square-foot retail warehouse at 2430 W. Indian School Road. The company operates as a wholesale restaurant supply store open to the public with no membership required.

The Phoenix facility stocks more than 7,000 items (with the store manager citing 15,000+), ranging from fresh meats, seafood, produce, and dairy to disposables, kitchen supplies, dry goods, and grocery products. The assortment includes hundreds of Arizona-grown or manufactured items and a selection tailored to the Hispanic market. Services include buy-online-pick-up-in-store and phone orders with products ready for pickup.

The store serves food trucks, caterers, small businesses, and the general public, positioning itself as a one-stop shop for foodservice operators in the Phoenix area. It is open seven days a week from 7 a.m. to 7 p.m.

Management emphasizes personal service and local sourcing: “Let our Phoenix store be your one-stop shop for the best quality products and superb customer service that can’t be beat! … We treat our customers like friends!” The company also promotes a “Think local. Shop Shamrock.” approach, highlighting Arizona brands.
